g.text: NVIDIA vs Trainium vs Google TPU: memory per chip
Bar length = HBM capacity per chip. Label = capacity · bandwidth. All three are fabbed by TSMC.
NVIDIA sells to every cloud and on-prem buyer. Trainium only exists inside AWS (EC2, Bedrock).
TPUs only exist inside Google Cloud. All three run Claude: Trainium2 (Project Rainier), TPUs (up to 1M), NVIDIA GPUs.
